soldQuantity.title: Sold Quantity Check
soldQuantity.description: Look up how many units of a product have sold within a time frame, based on each order's payment date. Enter the exact product code, or search by name and pick from a list.
soldQuantity.loading: Looking up sales for this time frame…
soldQuantity.searchByNameHint: Type at least 2 characters to search
soldQuantity.lookupError: Could not look up that product code

titleAsterisk.title: Title Asterisk Check
titleAsterisk.description: Look up a product by code or name and see whether its title currently ends in "*" (Shopfa's inventory follow-up flag), then flip it.
titleAsterisk.searchByNameHint: Type at least 2 characters to search
titleAsterisk.checkError: Could not look up that product
titleAsterisk.liveApiRequired: Toggling requires the Live API data source (see Settings) -- imported order data has no product catalog to update.
titleAsterisk.toggleNotApplied: Shopfa accepted the request but the title did not actually change on the server. Please edit the title manually in the Shopfa admin dashboard.

orderNote.title: Order Admin Note
orderNote.description: Look up an order by its order number and read or change its admin note ("یادداشت مدیر" in the Shopfa dashboard).
orderNote.lookupError: Could not look up that order
orderNote.saveNotApplied: Shopfa accepted the request but the note did not actually change on the server. Please edit it manually in the Shopfa admin dashboard.
orderNote.liveApiRequired: This tool requires the Live API data source (see Settings) -- imported order data has no admin note field.
